                    const k = states['sensor.wn_jib_current_condition']?.state;
                    const w = states['weather.wn_jib']?.state;
                    return (k && k !== 'unknown' && k !== 'unavailable') ? k : (w ?? '—');
                  ]]]
                label: |
                  [[[
                    const w = states['weather.wn_jib'];
                    const a = w?.attributes || {};
                    // 여러 공급자 호환: temperature / current_temperature / temp
                    const t = a.temperature ?? a.current_temperature ?? a.temp;
                    if (typeof t === 'number' && isFinite(t)) {
                      return `${t}<span style="font-size:0.6cm;">°C</span>`;
                    }
                    // 마지막 유효 값이 input_number 등에 저장되어 있다면 여기서 불러와도 됨
                    return '—';
                  ]]]
                show_label: true
                custom_fields:
                  icon: |
                    [[[
                      let st = states['weather.wn_jib']?.state || 'unknown';

                      // normalize: 소문자 + 공백/언더스코어 → 하이픈
                      st = (st + '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g,'-').replace(/_/g,'-');

                      const map = {
                        'partly-cloudy': 'partlycloudy',   // 우리 폴더 파일명
                        'mostly-cloudy': 'partlycloudy',
                        'mostlycloudy':  'partlycloudy',
                        'overcast':      'cloudy'
                        // 필요하면 여기 더 추가
                      };
                      const bad = ['unknown','unavailable','none',''];

                      const key = map[st] || st;
                      if (bad.includes(st)) {
                        return `<ha-icon icon="mdi:weather-cloudy" style="width:42px;height:42px;opacity:.7"></ha-icon>`;
                      }

                      return `<img src="/local/ic/weather_icons/animated2/${key}.svg" width="54" height="54"
                                  onerror="this.outerHTML='<ha-icon icon=&quot;mdi:weather-cloudy&quot; style=&quot;width:42px;height:42px;opacity:.7&quot;></ha-icon>'">`;

                                    // ---- PRNG ----
                                    function mulberry32(a){
                                      let t = a + 0x6D2B79F5;
                                      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
                                      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
                                      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
                                    }
                                    const seed = Number(states['input_number.lotto']?.state || 0);
                                    let rnd = mulberry32(seed);

                                    // ---- 번호 뽑기 ----
                                    const pool = Array.from({length: 45}, (_, i) => i + 1);
                                    function pickOne(){
                                      const idx = Math.floor(rnd * pool.length);
                                      const val = pool.splice(idx, 1)[0];
                                      rnd = mulberry32(Math.floor(rnd * 1e9) ^ (seed + pool.length));
                                      return val;
                                    }
                                    const main = [];
                                    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) main.push(pickOne());
